description:
A neat little application that allows you to draw on your screen

iScribby is a screen-drawing application: use it anywhere — on your desktop, while browsing the internet, or even in a video game — to draw, highlight, and annotate directly on the screen during presentations, streams, and lessons.
- Fix - auto-hidden taskbar not appearing as needed, while running the app.
- Implemented fading ink setting - you can now have drawings that fade out and erase themselves automatically.
- Added the ability to form a perfect square using marquee tool when holding down shift.
- Added a setting to allow disabling the behavior that constantly forces the window to render above everything. Can be useful in instances when app ends up conflicting with another one.
